regime_context: The detector shows a single-dominant-theme market: Banks are rank 1 with score 0.995, eligible under the trend gate, crowded (z=1.74), and have near-zero breadth, while only 2 of 22 themes are even trend-eligible (breadth-of-rotation 0.09, view 'narrow'). However, the backtest verdict explicitly states the absolute-trend gate did NOT reduce drawdown on China A-shares history (gate_helps=false, mean-reverting tape), so the one validated edge is absent here; with a track_record hit rate of 0.548 but directional accuracy of only 0.373 over 126 calls, I default to very low conviction across the board.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Defense & Aerospace (512660.SS) crosses into trend-eligible territory (eligible flips true) while Banks lose their eligibility or breadth expands from 0.0; the condition that retires this watch is CN Defense remaining non-eligible for three consecutive weeks while Banks hold rank 1 with score above 0.9 and one_narrative stays true.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the sole trend-eligible leader with dominant rank (0.995) and a durability_bar (0.52) that is the highest among eligible themes, suggesting the trend regime is intact on a hurst_tag 'trend'. Crowding (z=1.74) is a size-down caution only, not a fade. This is a lean on trend continuation, not a return forecast, and is heavily discounted because gate_helps=false means the trend discipline has no drawdown edge on this market's history.
theses.dissent: Banks have breadth=0.0 and crowding_z=1.74 — the entire 'trend' is a very narrow, crowded single-name-style flow; on a mean-reverting A-share tape with no validated trend-gate edge, this leadership can reverse hard and fast.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS closes below its 20-day moving average at any point before the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: Defense & Aerospace
theses.thesis: Defense is rank 2 with score 0.485, the only plausible challenger to Banks, and is NOT crowded (z=-0.89), unlike the leader. However, it is not trend-eligible (eligible=false), which is the detector's one drawdown-control leg and the only leg with any historical edge — and even that leg failed on this market. So this is a very tentative lean on relative strength among non-crowded challengers, more of a watch than a call.
theses.dissent: Not trend-eligible means the absolute-trend gate would not hold it; on a mean-reverting tape this is exactly the kind of theme that whipsaws. With directional accuracy of 0.373, a challenger lean is a coin flip at best.

falsifier.text: 512660.SS breaks below its 20-day average while Banks hold above theirs before the check-by date

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma is the only other trend-eligible theme besides Banks (eligible=true, score 0.253), with a moderate durability_bar (0.44) and a 'mixed' hurst tag. It is crowded (z=1.94) so would be sized down, but it is one of only two themes the trend gate would actually admit. Nothing in the state supports more than a very modest preference on trend-gate eligibility alone, which itself has no drawdown edge here.
theses.dissent: Crowding z=1.94 and a 'mixed' trend-health tag suggest the theme is already extended and choppy; with gate_helps=false there is no validated reason to trust eligibility as a screen on this market.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ underperforms the CSI 300 by 3% over any rolling 10-day window before the 20-day check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
